<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_VascularAccess"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vascular-access">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VascularAccess" name="Vascular Access Puncture Procedure" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Procedure" name="Procedure starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Prepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareInstruments" name="Prepare implements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Prepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Prepare_Wash</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WashHands" name="Wash hands">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Prepare_Wash</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wash_Clothes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DonSterileClothes" name="Put on sterile clothes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wash_Clothes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clothes_Clean</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CleanPunctureArea" name="Clean puncture area">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clothes_Clean</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clean_Drape</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrapePunctureZone" name="Drape puncture zone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clean_Drape</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drape_Configure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" name="Configure ultrasound">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drape_Configure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Configure_Gel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GelIntoProbe" name="Put gel in probe">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Configure_Gel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gel_Cover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CoverProbe" name="Cover probe">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gel_Cover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cover_SterileGel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySterileGel" name="Put sterile gel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cover_SterileGel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SterileGel_PositionProbe</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionProbe" name="Position probe">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SterileGel_PositionProbe</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PositionProbe_PositionPatient</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionPatient" name="Position patient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PositionProbe_PositionPatient</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PositionPatient_VeinSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VeinSplit" name="Vein identification method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PositionPatient_VeinSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VeinSplit_Anatomic</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VeinSplit_Doppler</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VeinSplit_Compression</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnatomicIdentification" name="Identify vein anatomically">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VeinSplit_Anatomic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Anatomic_VeinJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DopplerIdentification" name="Identify vein by Doppler">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VeinSplit_Doppler</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Doppler_VeinJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompressionIdentification" name="Identify vein by compression">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VeinSplit_Compression</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compression_VeinJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VeinJoin" name="Vein identified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Anatomic_VeinJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Doppler_VeinJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compression_VeinJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VeinJoin_Anesthetize</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnesthetizePatient" name="Anesthetize patient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VeinJoin_Anesthetize</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Anesthetize_Puncture</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PunctureVein" name="Puncture patient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Anesthetize_Puncture</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BloodReturn_Repuncture</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WirePosition_Repuncture</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Puncture_CheckBloodReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBloodReturn" name="Check blood return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Puncture_CheckBloodReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBloodReturn_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BloodReturnSplit" name="Blood return correct?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBloodReturn_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BloodReturn_Repuncture</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BloodReturn_ReleaseProbe</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReleaseProbe" name="Release probe">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BloodReturn_ReleaseProbe</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReleaseProbe_RemoveSyringe</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveSyringe" name="Remove syringe">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReleaseProbe_RemoveSyringe</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RemoveSyringe_InstallGuidewire</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallGuidewire" name="Install guidewire">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RemoveSyringe_InstallGuidewire</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InstallGuidewire_RemoveTrocar</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveTrocar" name="Remove trocar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InstallGuidewire_RemoveTrocar</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RemoveTrocar_WireCheckSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" name="Wire check method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RemoveTrocar_WireCheckSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WireCheckSplit_LongAxis</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WireCheckSplit_ShortAxis</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" name="Check wire in long axis">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WireCheckSplit_LongAxis</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LongAxis_WireCheckJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" name="Check wire in short axis">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WireCheckSplit_ShortAxis</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShortAxis_WireCheckJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckJoin" name="Wire checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LongAxis_WireCheckJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShortAxis_WireCheckJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WireCheckJoin_CheckWirePosition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWirePosition" name="Check wire position">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WireCheckJoin_CheckWirePosition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckWirePosition_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WirePositionSplit" name="Wire in good position?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckWirePosition_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WirePosition_Repuncture</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WirePosition_WidenPathway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WidenPathway" name="Widen pathway">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WirePosition_WidenPathway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WidenPathway_AdvanceCatheter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdvanceCatheter" name="Advance catheter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WidenPathway_AdvanceCatheter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdvanceCatheter_RemoveGuidewire</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveGuidewire" name="Remove guidewire">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdvanceCatheter_RemoveGuidewire</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RemoveGuidewire_VerifyFlow</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" name="Verify flow and reflow">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RemoveGuidewire_VerifyFlow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VerifyFlow_CheckCatheter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" name="Check catheter position">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VerifyFlow_CheckCatheter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckCatheter_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Procedure" name="Catheter placement verified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckCatheter_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Prepare" sourceRef="Start_Procedure" targetRef="Task_PrepareInstruments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Wash" sourceRef="Task_PrepareInstruments" targetRef="Task_WashHands"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wash_Clothes" sourceRef="Task_WashHands" targetRef="Task_DonSterileClothes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clothes_Clean" sourceRef="Task_DonSterileClothes" targetRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clean_Drape" sourceRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea" targetRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drape_Configure" sourceRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone" targetRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Configure_Gel" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" targetRef="Task_GelIntoProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gel_Cover" sourceRef="Task_GelIntoProbe" targetRef="Task_CoverProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cover_SterileGel" sourceRef="Task_CoverProbe" targetRef="Task_ApplySterileGel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SterileGel_PositionProbe" sourceRef="Task_ApplySterileGel" targetRef="Task_PositionProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PositionProbe_PositionPatient" sourceRef="Task_PositionProbe" targetRef="Task_PositionPatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PositionPatient_VeinSplit" sourceRef="Task_PositionPatient" targetRef="Gateway_VeinSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VeinSplit_Anatomic" name="Anatomic" sourceRef="Gateway_VeinSplit" targetRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VeinSplit_Doppler" name="Doppler" sourceRef="Gateway_VeinSplit" targetRef="Task_DopplerIdentification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VeinSplit_Compression" name="Compression" sourceRef="Gateway_VeinSplit" targetRef="Task_CompressionIdentification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Anatomic_VeinJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_VeinJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Doppler_VeinJoin" sourceRef="Task_DopplerIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_VeinJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compression_VeinJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompressionIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_VeinJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VeinJoin_Anesthetize" sourceRef="Gateway_VeinJoin" targetRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Anesthetize_Puncture" sourceRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient" targetRef="Task_PunctureVein"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Puncture_CheckBloodReturn" sourceRef="Task_PunctureVein" targetRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBloodReturn_Split" sourceRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn" targetRef="Gateway_BloodReturnSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodReturn_Repuncture" name="Not correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturnSplit" targetRef="Task_PunctureVein"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodReturn_ReleaseProbe" name="Correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturnSplit" targetRef="Task_ReleaseProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReleaseProbe_RemoveSyringe" sourceRef="Task_ReleaseProbe" targetRef="Task_RemoveSyringe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveSyringe_InstallGuidewire" sourceRef="Task_RemoveSyringe" targetRef="Task_InstallGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallGuidewire_RemoveTrocar" sourceRef="Task_InstallGuidewire" targetRef="Task_RemoveTrocar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveTrocar_WireCheckSplit" sourceRef="Task_RemoveTrocar" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheckSplit_LongAxis" name="Long axis" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheckSplit_ShortAxis" name="Short axis" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LongAxis_WireCheckJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShortAxis_WireCheckJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheckJoin_CheckWirePosition" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckWirePosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckWirePosition_Split" sourceRef="Task_CheckWirePosition" targetRef="Gateway_WirePositionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WirePosition_Repuncture" name="Not good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePositionSplit" targetRef="Task_PunctureVein"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WirePosition_WidenPathway" name="Good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePositionSplit" targetRef="Task_WidenPathway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WidenPathway_AdvanceCatheter" sourceRef="Task_WidenPathway" targetRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdvanceCatheter_RemoveGuidewire" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RemoveGuidewire_VerifyFlow" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VerifyFlow_CheckCatheter" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCatheter_End" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="End_Procedure"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
